fact: INStaD published the main indicators of the national EHCVM (2021-2022, fieldwork 2021 and 2022), representative for the 12 departments and by residence area, across 13 themes and about ten SDG indicators.
INSAE states the fourth census (RGPH4) was enumerated nationwide from 11 to 31 May 2013 by about 17,500 field staff and counted 10,008,749 residents.
INSAE states the Council of Ministers adopted the definitive RGPH4 results on 21 May 2015, and the definitive results leaflet is dated June 2015.

INStaD director general Laurent Mahounou announced that main mapping for the fifth census (RGPH5) began on 19 March 2024 in the remaining 74 communes for two months, after a pilot in Cotonou, Cove and Parakou.

INStaD says it trained about fifty trainers from 22 to 25 January 2024 ahead of cartographic mapping for the fifth census (RGPH5), after a mapping pilot in Cotonou, Cove and Parakou in September-October 2023.
